EAT-R235.title: Registered workflow_execute MUST execute an admitted kind:function definition
EAT-R235.statement: The registered `workflow_execute` tool MUST, for an exactly allowlisted saved `kind:function` definition whose descriptor/export pin and admission checks pass, call the installed producer host, mint a Pi logical invocation ID, and return provider-qualified refs — replacing the pin-time refusal with a real function branch, editing only the P04 surfaces (`src/workbench/execute-tool.ts`, `src/index.ts`, optionally `execute.ts`, a narrow Mechanical adapter under `src/workbench/hosts/`).
EAT-R235.maps: P04; B-dispatch (C157 ESTABLISHED); extends EAT-R032, EAT-R054.
EAT-R235.tier: V3 (native proof deferred to P07 — EAT-R259).

EAT-R236.title: Script workflows MUST remain byte/behavior compatible after the function branch lands
EAT-R236.statement: Landing the function branch MUST leave all existing script golden fixtures, workflow tool names and the reply dialect byte/behavior compatible where pi-02 requires it, and MUST NOT register duplicate workflow tool names.

EAT-R237.title: furnace-formula MUST stay an explicit refusal outside the Mechanical adapter
EAT-R237.statement: After the function branch lands, a `furnace-formula` definition MUST still be refused with the explicit unsupported diagnostic, and MUST never be routed into the Mechanical adapter, any producer import, or any effect.

EAT-R238.title: Invalid definition, permissions or source MUST never enter the producer on the registered path
EAT-R238.statement: The registered function branch MUST compose final function authority and writer source admission into its one effectful dispatch chain so that any invalid definition, permission or source state is refused before descriptor import, producer call or any effect, with no await between the final grant decision and the single dispatch.
EAT-R238.maps: P04; B-dispatch (composes B-authority/B-source outputs); extends EAT-R025, EAT-R030, EAT-R031.

EAT-R239.title: Function state MUST live in the existing Workbench task/observation store
EAT-R239.statement: Function invocation state MUST be registered in the existing Workbench task/observation store; the function path MUST NOT introduce a parallel hidden task table.
EAT-R239.maps: P04; B-dispatch; prior: none directly (complements EAT-R032).

EAT-R240.title: The function launch MUST return promptly with completion:not-asserted
EAT-R240.statement: The registered function branch MUST persist launch intention, schedule execution asynchronously, and return `completion: not-asserted` plus provider-qualified refs promptly; it MUST NOT block the tool reply on workflow completion and MUST NOT assert completion at launch.

EAT-R241.title: The P04 gate receipt MUST encode its evidence level
EAT-R241.statement: The P04 gate receipt (`PI-FUNCTION-REGISTERED`) MUST derive from a real registered-path controlled test (not a stub typed helper) and MUST encode its evidence level (V3, injected callbacks) wherever the label is emitted, so it cannot be read as MW M06's native exit of the same name; until the P00/M00 receipt-vocabulary ruling, every emission carries the level marker.

EAT-R242.title: All four original Mechanical outcomes MUST project through the registered route
EAT-R242.statement: `workflow_execute` plus `workflow_observe` MUST carry each of the four original `DevelopmentOutcome` variants — `verified_candidate`, `verification_failed`, `needs_evidence`, `indeterminate` — end-to-end, asserting the complete original outcome payload and the separate host envelope, never only a `kind` string.
EAT-R242.tier: V3 (native V4 instances arrive at P07 — EAT-R260).

EAT-R243.title: Observation MUST NOT collapse domain, transport and process statuses
EAT-R243.statement: Pi MUST never coerce `needs_evidence` or `indeterminate` into failure, nor `verification_failed` into a transport error; transport-level success and the Mechanical domain outcome MUST remain separately readable on every reply.

EAT-R244.title: Observation MUST project separate axes and preserve unknowns explicitly
EAT-R244.statement: Function observation MUST project, as separate fields: launch/admission, execution status, original Mechanical domain outcome, native Forge verdict/operation and complete-gate selection, source commit/tree/freshness, effect disposition, and provider-qualified refs; missing fields and unknown states MUST be preserved explicitly, never defaulted, fabricated, or implied by omission.

EAT-R245.title: Gate credit MUST be freshness- and identity-bound
EAT-R245.statement: Observation MUST revoke current-gate credit whenever the gate does not bind the exact current candidate: native PASS with mismatched tree, partial/incomplete gate, transport exit 0 with native FAIL, stale tree after PASS, or a no-code-change candidate MUST never read as a current verified PASS; historical proof stays visible with freshness `stale`.
EAT-R245.maps: P05; B-observe (joins B-git-census at P07); extends EAT-R038, EAT-R052.
EAT-R245.tier: V3 (native freshness instances at V4 in P07).

EAT-R246.title: The invocation MUST remain addressable after the initiating turn
EAT-R246.statement: A function invocation MUST remain addressable by its Pi logical invocation ID after the initiating model turn finishes; reopening an archived invocation MUST return the exact domain outcome, native refs and source identity.

EAT-R247.title: Model-facing output MUST stay bounded while structured detail retains native identifiers
EAT-R247.statement: Model-facing observation output MUST respect the byte budget and redaction while native IDs, evidence-gap and source-stale labels remain present in structured detail; a UI success glyph MUST NOT read as native Forge PASS without current proof.

EAT-R248.title: Observer gaps and missing identities MUST read as gaps, not success
EAT-R248.statement: A dropped or out-of-order observer cursor, a blank agent session, an absent Forge operation ID, or a missing candidate tree MUST render as an explicit gap/stale/unknown diagnostic and MUST never imply successful completion or any verified claim.

EAT-R249.title: Profile reporting MUST be adoption-gated and factual
EAT-R249.statement: Until the P00/M00 ABI adopts host-owned evidence/context profile selectors, Pi observation and receipts MUST NOT present `evidenceProfile`/`contextProfile` values (including `git-census-v1`/`plain-v1`) as executed; after adoption and live execution, Pi MUST record and report the profile identifiers actually used by the invocation, witnessed from the producer side.
EAT-R249.maps: P05; B-observe (vocabulary shared with B-git-census); prior: none (new audit finding).
EAT-R249.tier: V3 pre-adoption; V4 for live reporting.

EAT-R250.title: Durable intent MUST precede any writer/claim/gate dispatch
EAT-R250.statement: The function path MUST journal a durable local intent record before any writer, claim or gate dispatch and append settled native refs afterward, reusing the existing workflow journal rather than a new store.

EAT-R251.title: Uncertain effects MUST resolve only by native readback
EAT-R251.statement: On lost acknowledgment, cancel, or process death, the function path MUST reconcile through Git/Forge native readback using the recovery oracle — `occurred` only from producer-native evidence; `not-occurred` only from positive authoritative absence at a queryable identity and current source; `unknown` from an incomplete read — reusing Mechanical's typed `DevelopmentAbortedAfterDispatchError` / `DevelopmentLostAcknowledgementError` semantics.
EAT-R251.maps: P06; B-effects / B-replay; extends EAT-R043, EAT-R044.
EAT-R251.tier: V3 (full process-kill matrix at V5 — EAT-R256/R257 and the P09 sibling lane).

EAT-R252.title: Stop semantics MUST be pre/post-dispatch asymmetric and never rollback
EAT-R252.statement: A stop requested before dispatch MUST prevent any SDK session; a stop after dispatch MUST record cancellation-requested with effect disposition uncertain/occurred and MUST NOT claim rollback; late candidate/gate evidence MUST stay visible; a cancellation request MUST never close Beads, reset Git, reverse a Forge gate, or undo a Furnace Attempt.
EAT-R252.maps: P06; B-controls; extends EAT-R045, EAT-R046, EAT-R047, EAT-R070.

EAT-R253.title: The parked-beforeDispatch skip/retry loss MUST be repaired before effectful dispatch
EAT-R253.statement: Pi MUST honor a per-agent skip or retry issued while `beforeDispatch` is parked (the witnessed wb-9v02 defect), so the pending cancel takes effect at the exact barrier and no late SDK query starts; this repair MUST land before any effectful function dispatch is enabled.
EAT-R253.maps: P06; B-cancel-repro; bead wb-9v02 (per M006), epic wb-1a3t (C158 ESTABLISHED); extends EAT-R015, EAT-R016, EAT-R160.

EAT-R254.title: Effect count MUST stay <=1 absent native not-occurred evidence
EAT-R254.statement: Across journal replay, duplicate control events and host restart, the function path MUST keep native effect attempts at <=1 per authorized invocation; a new dispatch is permitted only after positively evidenced not-occurred plus newly authorized source; repeated cancel/reconcile events MUST be idempotent.
EAT-R254.maps: P06; B-replay; extends EAT-R021, EAT-R043, EAT-R044.
EAT-R254.tier: V3 behavioral; process-death instances at V5 (EAT-R256).

EAT-R255.title: Failed preservation MUST never trigger destructive cleanup on the function path
EAT-R255.statement: The function host MUST use the safe `cleanupWorktree` path: on a status/add/commit/branch preservation failure it MUST surface the typed preservation-failed result (kept path plus diagnostic, with the changed tracked and untracked bytes retained at the kept worktree/HEAD) and MUST NOT invoke destructive cleanup or report a false clean.
EAT-R255.maps: P06; B-preserve; extends EAT-R001, EAT-R002, EAT-R003, EAT-R144.

EAT-R256.title: P06 fault tests MUST record the full before/after evidence set at controlled barriers
EAT-R256.statement: Every P06 fault test MUST record full tracked and untracked worktree bytes, HEAD/index, source/permission basis, native-effect attempt count and the Pi journal before and after; each fault MUST be injected at an independently controlled barrier; the P06 matrix MUST cover at least: parked startup + per-agent skip, during-edit abort, after-commit-before-ack, gate-sent-reply-lost, restored Pi session, duplicate events/cancels, and host-process-killed-and-reattached — with inspection after a separate process restart where feasible.
EAT-R256.maps: P06; B-controls; extends EAT-R086, EAT-R168, EAT-R170.
EAT-R256.tier: V5 for process-kill members; V3 for in-process barriers.

EAT-R257.title: SDK-child host death MUST gain its missing test
EAT-R257.statement: Pi MUST add the named missing evidence for host death: a test that kills the SDK child process mid-query and asserts the settled result/journal state — the session identified as unknown/active or explicitly unknown, a stale/unknown observer cursor with reattach id and ref, and no auto-repeat without a native read.
EAT-R257.maps: P06; B-controls; prior: none (named audit gap).

EAT-R258.title: The function path MUST NOT add a second scheduler or duplicate Furnace
EAT-R258.statement: The function execution path MUST reuse existing dispatch/journal/reconcile authorities and MUST NOT introduce a new scheduler inside Pi nor duplicate Furnace's durable Run/Work/Attempt ownership; in the optional detached/Furnace mode, reconciliation MUST go through the native controller/Run/Attempt, never a bespoke local scheduler.
EAT-R258.tier: V0 census plus V3 behavioral tie-in.

EAT-R259.title: The first live journey MUST bind registered route, native writer, native gate and observation into one V4 receipt
EAT-R259.statement: P07 MUST execute the real registered `workflow_execute(kind:function)` with the exact independently packed Mechanical host on an isolated scratch Forge package, where one genuine native Claude SDK writer produces a changed clean commit/tree, the native Forge full gate binds that candidate, and `workflow_observe` returns the original domain and refs; the receipt MUST carry the full V4 field set — pinned versions, SDK session ID, Pi logical invocation ID, Mechanical domain, gate operation ID/selection, source base/commit/tree, matching candidate commit/tree and gate manifest, definition/descriptor/package digests, and the exact input task — all from producer-native API evidence, never an assistant's summary.
EAT-R259.maps: P07; B-git-census; extends EAT-R054, EAT-R055, EAT-R085.

EAT-R260.title: The live journey MUST include native PASS, native FAIL and unknown/refusal variants
EAT-R260.statement: P07 MUST produce three genuine native variations — one true PASS, one native Forge FAIL, and one unknown/partial/dirty refusal — each through the registered route with producer-native IDs; no fixture or proxy result may be counted as native.

EAT-R261.title: The P07 gate MUST join only producer-defined receipts
EAT-R261.statement: The P07 joint gate MUST be configured over receipt labels that have a producer-side definition at gate time — at the pins that is MW M06's actual exit pair (`PI-FUNCTION-REGISTERED` then `PI-GIT-CENSUS-LIVE`) or the P00/M00-adopted set — and MUST NOT wait on `MW-PI-NATIVE-LIVE`, which no MW document or repository defines.
EAT-R261.maps: P07; B-git-census (ruling input: B-contract-choice); extends EAT-R085, EAT-R086.
EAT-R261.tier: V0 config truth, enforced again at V4 execution.

EAT-R262.title: P07 profile instantiation MUST wait for ratified selectors and record executed literals
EAT-R262.statement: P07 MUST instantiate `git-census-v1`/`plain-v1` only after the P00/M00 ABI lands those selectors in producer and consumer code; its receipts MUST name the selector literals actually executed, witnessed from the installed producer package, and MUST NOT present an unratified identifier as an executed profile.

EAT-R263.title: Unavailable credentials or binaries MUST record BLOCKED, never an imitation pass
EAT-R263.statement: When credentials or binaries for the live journey are unavailable, the P07 receipt MUST record status BLOCKED naming the missing prerequisite; no imitation pass, fabricated native ID, or PARTIAL-relabeled-PASS is permitted; a gate or requirement label becomes an actual claim only with a passing receipt on a pinned candidate.
